findings.title: Briefing xpAvailable offers the mission bonus for a complete mission that has no bonus row
findings.resolution: Gamification.available returns 0 when no task is left to resolve (design decision 8); together with the F03 reconciliation a complete, unpaid mission cannot persist. GamificationIT "practice from before the ledger is credited once at startup" (xpAvailable 0 for the complete mission before reconciliation).

findings.title: Unreadable config resource surfaces as a raw IOException rather than InvalidGamificationConfig
findings.resolution: GamificationSettings refuses a resource that does not exist or is not readable and maps an IOException on read to InvalidGamificationConfig("doucko.gamification.config"). GamificationConfigTest "an invalid file stops the start and names the key" (directory case).

findings.title: No ledger backfill for primary-scope resolutions and completed missions from before V5
findings.resolution: Fixed rather than argued: slice 7 is on main, so a database may hold practice from before V5. Gamification.reconcile runs on ApplicationReadyEvent under the practice lock, append-only and idempotent: a TASK award for each primary-scope resolution without one (resolving attempt hints, linked to it) and the bonus of each complete, unpaid served mission; a crossed rank becomes pendingRankUp. Design decision 10. GamificationIT "practice from before the ledger is credited once at startup", GamificationServiceTest "the reconciliation skips unresolved and already credited tasks".

findings.title: Every read and write reloads and sums the entire XP ledger several times per request
findings.resolution: XpLedger gained awardsOf(attemptId) (uses xp_award_attempt_idx), total() (SQL sum), taskAwarded(taskId) and bonusesPaid(missionIds); only the summary loads the whole ledger. Covered by GamificationIT and GamificationServiceTest.

findings.title: xpAvailable assumes firstAttempt is the maximum award, which is wrong when minimum > firstAttempt
findings.resolution: XpRules.bestAward = the highest of the three awards after the minimum, without hints; available() uses it. GamificationRulesTest "the available XP per task is the best award a task can still earn".

findings.title: Undocumented rule: rank names are limited to 50 characters and duplicate JSON keys are refused
findings.resolution: Documented instead of dropped: the delta spec and design decision 2 state rank names 1 to 50 code points (HQ badge) and that duplicate keys are refused; GamificationConfigTest covers 50 accepted / 51 refused and the duplicate key. The store spec is unchanged (the limit is an implementation bound of this repo).
